description: This file defines the ProductPurchased class, a model component for reporting purchased products in an OpenCart admin extension. It provides functions to retrieve and count product purchase data with filtering options based on order status and date ranges.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: A model class for fetching product purchase report data, including methods to retrieve purchased products and total counts based on filters.

methods.name: getPurchased
methods.description: Retrieves a list of purchased products with total quantities and totals, filtered by order status and date range.

methods.name: getTotalPurchased
methods.description: Returns the total number of distinct products purchased, filtered by order status and date range.
